messages.text: You still need my folding table from the shop for Saturday?
Yes please. After hoops I can grab it. Luis said he can carry the rice pot too.
Good. Tell Ahmed not to park behind the bay door again.
I will. Ms. Evelyn asked for extra ginger this time, so I need one more stop before setup.
Soup is low. Save me one bowl if Nico does not finish.
I saved yours. Left the lid cracked because the ginger steam was catching the stove light.
Ok. Also move your record sleeve away from the counter before it gets damp.
Moved it. The Miles one is on the table now.
Coach moved pickup to 6:10. Is there food before I go?
Rice is in the cooker. I opened the small fish cans and put cucumber on the side.
Can you get bananas too? Aldi ones were gone last time.
I will check the stand on Hillside after Aldi. If they are too soft, apples only.
Do we still have cereal or should I stop after practice?
When you get home, move the two red pots by the fence so the cold air doesn't hit them tonight.
Come straight home. We have rice, eggs, and soup. No extra stop tonight.
The ones with the small green leaves or the tomato sticks?
Small leaves. Tomato sticks can stay. Also don't kick the black tray near the hose.
Ok. Is the museum thing with Marielle still happening Saturday?
Ok. I moved them next to the wall before practice.
Not this Saturday. I moved that small Dr. Reyes slot again and we are keeping the weekend simple.
Can you save dinner? practice running late
Yes. Chicken is still on low, and the trumpet record is keeping me patient.
If practice ends on time, come straight home. I saved rice and the orange slices.
lol the scratchy one again?
Coach said 7:20. Can I eat in front of the TV?
The same box from our first apartment near Hillside. It survived better than my old school notebooks.
Only if your shoes stay by the door. I want the 4th quarter without mud in the hallway.
Lol ok. Don't yell at Brunson before I get there.
Ma said the bitter melon you left was easier on her hands than the fish. She ate twice.
Ma's pharmacy said the copay is $42. Can you cover it today and I'll send you half Friday?
Good. I sliced it thin so she can just warm it. I also wrote the stove steps big on the tape.
Yes. I moved the ConEd reminder and put H Mart for after pickup. Lani's agency deposit lands tonight, so I can float it.
Ok. Don't start adding every bill in your head at once. Wait until she gets home.
Can you do that same big-letter card for the Flushing center pot on Friday? Mrs. Lim asked after smelling it.
I know. I already wrote the numbers on the fridge board instead of doing it in my head.
Yes. I will bring two versions, less salt and regular, and let them stir the garlic first.
Clinic intake for Ma asks for interpreter notes again. She said to write 'mẹ wants me there,' then switched to 'anak, don't forget the sugar numbers.'
That is exactly Ma. Put me for Thursday. I can handle her mix better than the front desk.
Also the form has the checkbox page. Same as before? They asked twice because of Dayrit.
Same as before. No on that first origin question, then I write Dad's Pampanga side and Ma's Saigon side in the details.
You left early? Rice cooker is on warm.
Doing the short river-side loop by the 59th St ramp before work. Back soon.
Okay. Please don’t stop at that little shop window again until ConEd clears.
I know. The blue 11x14 can wait.
Dad, don't use that auntie repost. Send me the screenshot and I'll find the city page.
Dad did you see the Queens Museum post with the mirror room clips? It showed up right under that noodle place you saved.
It says seniors should skip the new COVID dose if they had one last year. Sounds wrong.
Yes, saved both. The red dots one made me stop scrolling. Also the trumpet player from Jackson Heights posted a short from soundcheck.
Yeah, ignore. NYC Health says ask your doctor or check the CDC table. I can make the text bigger for you.
Send me that one. And don't forget the Turrell sky thing I tagged you in.
Okay. I want the right answer before I go to Flushing with Ma this weekend.
I put it in the same folder with the dumpling photos and the Queens street corner shots.
After practice, save 10 minutes for the school heritage board. Bring the photo of Lola's old Manila apartment and Mom's Da Nang recipe card.
Ok but Coach might go late
That's fine. Also leave space on the board for the neighbors' stories from the mosque fundraiser and Mr. Alvarez's union thing. I don't want it only about us.
Got it. I'll put blank cards so people can add stuff.
For the center flyer, do you want the photo of the soup pot or the one with your hand cutting ginger?
The ginger one. Mr. Santos used to say hands tell the story better than faces.
That sounds like something from an old movie. Also should I draw the apron or the blue shirt?
Blue shirt. I wore ones like that early, so it fits the cooking table.
Can I use the table after dinner for homework or you doing your camera stuff there?
I just need one corner. Going through the Jamaica Ave pictures and testing that little brush set Marielle sent.
The one with the bus stop reflection? That one looked cool on your phone.
Yes, after dishes I want to crop it tighter and try the same colors on paper.
If Nanay stays in Queens Village Saturday, can she use Marielle's room or is Marielle coming back from Albany?
Marielle stays upstate until break. Room is clear, just her boxes and winter coat.
Good. I can bring her after the pharmacy run. No extra cot needed then?
No cot. Lani, Nico, and me will keep the hallway quiet for her.
I found Ma's blue biscuit tin with the needles and tiny scissors. Do you want it or should I keep it here?
Keep the tiny scissors for her. I can take the thimble. She used to tap my hand if the cuff was crooked.
She still says you were fast but rushed the corners when you had to get to the store.
That was the year I stopped carrying books every day. Corners had to be clean anyway.
Lani wake up. My chest is tight and my shirt is wet. I keep opening the ConEd page and then thinking about Ma.
I am coming downstairs. Sit up, feet on floor. Do the 4 slow counts like the clinic paper.
Trying. The numbers keep jumping in my head.
Close the bill page now. Tea is heating. We check it after breakfast, not tonight.
You still got Manny's number from the Queens Reno crew? I need one of those old W-2 guys.
I have it. He was always cash Friday, paper later, so maybe he answers after lunch.
Same story. No office lady, no packet, just envelope and a handshake.
Yeah. I am sorting all that tonight with rent and the premium bill.
Dad, I fixed the March tab. The formula was skipping the Toyota row.
Thank you. I was wondering why the number looked too light after the house and Visa lines.
Also, submit the Queens Botanical workshop idea tonight. You already have the ingredient list.
Tonight? You know how to push your father. Send me the link again.
Can you pick me up after practice or are you doing the tray thing today?
I finish at 5. Mrs. Alvarez asked me to stack chairs too, so maybe 5:20.
Ok. Mom said there is that library thing tonight. Are you still going?
Yes, just to listen. Remind me to bring the small envelope from the kitchen drawer.
Corazon asked if you are still coming to Flushing after work. She saved you sinigang.
Yes, I can be there around 7:10. I called her this morning but she said the phone cut twice.
I will keep mine charged. Ramon said he cannot come from Jersey City tonight.
Okay. I will bring the arthritis cream and sit with her a bit.
You still have that basin wrench? My shop sink is dripping under the trap.
Yes, old red bag. I can talk you through it, but I am not crawling under there today.
Fair. Same bag from your apartment rounds?
Same one. Wrench, lock bits, outlet tester, spackle knife. That bag paid rent for many years.
You still messing with that furnace panel or you calling someone?
Only the small sensor bracket. Shutoff is off, and I watched the same part swapped twice before touching it.
Good. If it smells funny or sparks, close it and call.
Yes. Same rule as the old Queens Village shelves: I do the simple thing, stop when it gets risky.
You came home limping a little. Put the blue pack from freezer before shower.
Doing it now. Only stayed for two short games in Astoria.
Good. No ladder today. Nico can take trash out.
I tagged you in the Albany gallery photos on Instagram. The street mural one is your kind of thing.
Saw it with my coffee. Saved the mural and the food cart photo.
Do not open the comments under the campus budget post unless you want a headache.
I left one heart on your photo and closed that part.
Can you get me at 4:40 by the gym doors? Coach moved the scrimmage.
Yes. Text me when you are walking out. I packed the blue cleats.
After that can Jayden and Marco come over? We only need the TV until dinner.
Ask Lani first. Homework and dishes before controllers.
Save me the soccer pickup time. Also tell me if the broth in the back pot is too salty before I pack it.
6:20. It smells like the noodle place but stronger.
Good. Try one spoon only. I added ginger and fish sauce, maybe needs lime.
Needs lime. Also the orange wedges with sticky spicy honey are actually good.
Dad you left your phone buzzing by the couch
Put it on the hall charger please. I am washing the rice pot now.
Ok. Also crackers are still on the table from earlier
Cabinet them for me. I will make tea and leave the adobo alone.
Ma's ride is moved to Tuesday 11:20. Can you sit with her while I do pharmacy?
Yes. I will bring the blue folder too. The form asks for last month count again, so I wrote 0 shifts and $0.
Good. Also bring the 2021 notes if you still have them, the ones from when everything got too much on your body.
I found them. I still hate that part, but I don't miss rushing around after a bad night.
Bring that folder from the glove box when you come by. The expired insurance card is still in there.
I know. Last time on Hillside I reached too fast and the man at the window started talking slow like I could not understand English.
Then let me sort it before coffee. Also, at that senior meeting, ask them straight who answers when the old folks call after dark.
Yes. And I want them to explain what happens after a bad stop, not just shake hands for photos.
Dad, I fixed the formula on the March tab. The little red cell only turns on after $4,200 now.
Salamat. I wrote the same number in the notebook so I do not trust only the computer.
Keep the receipts in one pile, please. Last time the Aldi one was inside Nico's soccer bag.
Today they are clipped by the envelopes. Groceries already looks thin after H Mart.
I am leaving for the 10:00 at St. Joan. If your game bag is by the door, I can drop it after.
Bag is there. Can you save me pandesal too
Yes. Also don't move the red packet tray near the shelf, I still have to fix it from Tet.
Ok. I won't touch it
After your soccer game, remind me to stop by the library table. I want to check the address for the June site.
again? lol ok
Only five minutes. They have the little sheet with school board names and the bus question.
fine but no long lecture in the car please
I am going to Cunningham Park after I drop you. Want a ride back from practice or staying with Manny?
Manny's mom can bring me. You doing the long path?
Long enough to get my legs working. March air is finally not fighting me.
Ok don't race the aunties by the tennis courts lol
Coach said pickup at 6:20. Can we get pizza after?
Maybe one slice for me. I packed my little notebook and the cuff in the car, so remind me before we leave the field.
Ok. Also Uncle Rey has the card table near the garage again, so we can eat inside.
Good. I will stay inside, have seltzer, and take the knee tablet only if it gets ugly after standing.
Ma found the envelope from Manila in the dresser. It has your old stamped copy and the paper from after the oath here.
Keep it flat please. Lani says the passport packet needs clean scans, not phone shadows.
I will bring it when you come to Flushing. The corner with 1976 is faded but readable.
Salamat. I only need that page and the oath paper for now.
For Nico's board, I found a campus handout that pairs family food stories with tenant, worker, and classroom stories. Want me to send?
Send it. He knows adobo and pho, but I want him to ask why some people get stared at or told to move along.
I'll mark the parts that are good for a 10th grader.
Thanks. Keep it plain. No lecture, just enough so he notices.
Coach said tournament fee is due Friday. Also my cleats are kind of finished.
Ok, send me the paper when you get home. We handle that first.
Dad why did you like three ramen pics and then a guy playing bass in the subway lol
What about the cheap flight screenshot mom showed you?
Because the broth looked serious and the bass line was clean.
That stays as a screenshot for now. Tonight I will watch the Kyoto knife-work video while rice cooks.
Also you followed that Queens camera page I sent?
Yes. They caught Jamaica Ave in the rain better than I could.
My nurse at work said your sore arm is normal. Just warm compress, drink water.
Good. I was reading comments last night and they made it sound scary.
Don't read comments. Call Dr. Morales if fever. I left soup for you and Ma's pill box is by the door.
I will. Tell your client I stayed on schedule like you told me.
For the handout, maybe write the grocery amounts in tablespoons and cups. The aunties will roast you if it says 'some garlic.'
I fixed it. 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 stalk lemongrass, bay leaf. Tuesday batch is smaller so they can taste it.
Send me the page before you print. Also put the chili honey on the side so people can skip it.
Yes. I still need the wrapper filling cost from H Mart and the Filipino store receipt.
I cleaned up your one-page proposal. The strongest part is when people chop together before eating.
Can you leave the line about pairing the quiet tables with someone who speaks Tagalog or Vietnamese?
Kept it. Also added a tiny budget box: ginger, rice, greens, fish sauce, gloves, bowls.
Thank you. I still need to ask which certificate form wants hours and which wants supervisor signature.
Ma's pharmacy pickup is ready. Can you do Flushing after your 10-2 at the 218th St room?
I can. Bingo cards first, then I will take Q27 over.
Also Marielle sent the flyer you left on Ma's table. The one about complaint forms and traffic stops?
Yes, I only put a little in their box. Mostly wanted to hear people from the block.
You still awake looking at heater parts?
Comparing prices. I set the phone alarm for 10 so I stop poking at it.
Good. Eat real dinner, not peanuts from the jar like last time.
Too late, I had a few. Phone is on the charger now.
You still awake with that boiler estimate?
I fixed the loose wire but the pump quote is sitting on the table. I keep adding it with rent, Ma's medicine, Nico soccer.
Put the calculator down. Let Lani read it after her late case. Call me if you start pacing holes in the floor.
She texted she has tea when she gets in. I put the quote in the bill folder.
Before I leave for Mrs. Velasco, can you mark the card payment as pending? The roof repair part is still sitting there.
I put it on the blue tab. Marielle showed me how to freeze the top row so I don't lose the dates.
Good. Add the Albany book charge too, even if she says she can wait.
I will. After breakfast I also need to open that exhibit page she sent.
Nico forgot the permission slip on the counter. Can you bring it before practice?
I can leave in ten. I will put the sample ballot in the glove box too.
Good. If he rides with you, maybe show him where the check-in tables are.
Only if he finishes the math packet first. I want him home by dinner.
I get home 9:20. Please leave the hallway bulb until Nico can reach it.
I already put the ladder away. The twist this morning was enough.
Good. Also Teresa asked if you can do Flushing Friday before lunch.
Yes, after the form call. I will bring Ma's pillbox and the folder with my 2021 papers.
For my class tree, can I put 'Pampanga / Saigon / Paco' on your branch? Prof said places are better than neat boxes.
Yes. Add Queens 1991 under mine. Your Lola will correct spelling if you show her.
She already did. She also wrote 'ăn cơm chưa?' next to 'kumain ka na?' and said that is the real family motto.
For your Saturday recipe sheet, make the steps bigger. Mr. Tran probably should not have to squint at step 3.
That sounds right. English only came in when bills, school papers, or a landlord showed up.
Good point. I changed adobo vinegar to 1/3 cup and added Tagalog under the English.
I updated the spreadsheet. The December ConEd line was marked red, so I put the March catch-up under fixed stuff.
Also maybe ask Ms. Evelyn to taste before you print 20 copies?
Good. Keep the Queens Museum and bus fare idea gray for now.
She already told me less salt. Jun laughed and said listen to her, not me.
I saw the Dr. Reyes estimate tab too. Want me to move it below groceries?
Yes. Basics first until Lani's Friday deposit lands.
Dad, for Nico's spring trip form, do not mark the lines for card reload or rent case number if we do not have those.
Okay. I left those empty. I only wrote Lani's pay dates and my repair jobs.
Good. Also upload the Marketplace receipt, not that old shop paper. The old shop paper does not show anything useful.
I will scan it after dinner. Thank you anak.
After homework, please move the paint cans away from the basement heater. I need room to put the cover back.
Ok. Are we still sanding the hallway spot Saturday?
Small patch only. I saved the video and the manual page, but no touching wires.
Got it. Paint cans moved after I eat.
Ma wants you to bring the glucose strips when you come Flushing.
I can. I am on the platform now. Sun is making the yellow line shine like wet paint.
Only you notice that before coffee. Also if you pass that thrift place, check if they still have records.
If the old Blue Note bin is still there, I will look after Ma's strips.
If you pass by Flushing, the store near Mom has the green mung beans in the front bin again.
Good. I can soak some tonight and make a pot with onion and tomato.
Ma asked if you can bring a few leaves from the purple-stem one when you come to Flushing.
Thai basil? I can cut some after lunch. It is finally coming back.
Also Mom asked for the vinegar from the Filipino place, not the big supermarket one.
Yes that one. She wants it for soup, not too much.
I will stop there after her pharmacy. I still have garlic and eggs, so no extra bag.
I'll wrap it in a wet paper towel before I leave.
Ma's sugar was okay after dinner. Pharmacy pickup moved to Friday, I have it covered.
Good. I was about to call twice. I already checked the meter photo three times.
No need tonight. Put the phone away for ten minutes and do your slow counts.
Okay. Sorry if I sounded sharp earlier. My chest gets tight when bills and Ma happen together.
That heater part is $385 before tax if I order from my guy. Labor I can help you with coffee price.
I have the orange house envelope and some savings, maybe enough if nothing else jumps.
Do the math before you swipe. You always calm down better with the paper in front of you.
I will check the notebook tonight. If it passes $400 I may move groceries lower for one week.
Coffee tomorrow or you doing your bridge thing again?
Maybe both. Keeping it slow, just 20 minutes near Queens Plaza.
Good. And don’t come show me another tube from the frame place if the heater guy still wants cash.
You want that extra stool from the shop? Easier on the knees if you're sorting tools in the basement.
Already deleted the checkout link. Mostly.
Maybe. I was fixing Nico's bike and missed having people hand me something and trust me with it.
That part, yeah. The timer and boss voice, no thanks.
Exactly. Since 2021 the back says no before I even finish coffee.
At St. Gregory dinner they said Councilman Reyes coming Sunday with camera people.
If he has time for pancit, he has time for questions about home care hours and clinic bills.
I will ask Tita Rose to save you a seat near the back.
Back is good. I want to hear if he stays after the first picture.
Are you still doing the 8:30 Astoria thing tomorrow or resting this week?
I will see in the morning. If the joint is stiff I am just bringing coffee and watching.
Bring the wrap either way. Also send me a photo of the court, I need one for my Queens collage.
Okay anak. If I play, only one run.
Dad, for Thursday's meeting, the campus group made a one-page list: body-cam release dates, complaint numbers, and non-uniform teams for crisis calls.
Send it. But keep one question about older neighbors too. Lola's friend will not even buzz downstairs when someone is yelling outside.
I added that. And if they ask about your own experience, you do not have to tell the Hillside story unless you want.
Maybe just the part where I put both hands where he could see and still got treated like a child.
Coach moved pickup to 5:45. Can Marielle's chair stay in the garage or do I need to bring it upstairs?
Bring it upstairs before Lani gets home. Marielle will want her desk normal when she comes in.
Ok. Also Jayden asked if he can sleep over after FIFA night.
One night is fine if his mother knows. Use the basement couch, not Marielle's bed.
Dad did you see coach moved Saturday pickup to the other field?
Yes, saw the post after dishes. I put 10:30 on the fridge.
People are being weird in the replies again lol
Let them type. I only needed the field address.
You still got that little metal ruler? Need to mark a seat cover, straight line only.
Yes. Ma's old one. She made me measure twice even when customers were waiting.
Bring it after your morning thing. Coffee on me.
I can come 11. I have to finish Nico's school paperwork first. The grade box always makes me slow down.
Found a clean navy work shirt in the shop rag box. Not greasy. You still want one for your display thing?
Yes, if the pocket is plain. I am putting it beside the ladle photo, not making a big speech.
Good. Let the picture do work. Same way you fixed my brake flyer with one pencil mark.
That pencil mark came from years of being told to look twice before drawing once.
You still awake or did that 3rd quarter finish you off?
Awake. They gave up two soft ones and now I am washing dishes angry.
Better than throwing the sponge at the TV. Coffee Monday?
Monday works. I will bring the bracket printout and complain properly.
Sending the Albany gallery pics. The tea bowls one made me think of you and Mom.
Those shapes are beautiful. I saved the link next to the Kyoto notes.
Also my book charge posted: $63. Sorry, I know March is tight.
Send the receipt. Books first, bowls later.
Ma's pharmacy bag is ready. If you come by Flushing, can you bring your blue notebook too? Dr. Patel asked what your morning numbers have been.
Yes. I wrote this week's page. The top number was nicer after soup and walking, but I still need to be careful.
Good. Eat before you take anything for your back. You always try to stretch it out first anyway.
I will. No corner-store stuff for me today, just tea when I get there.
Ma asked if you still have the incense sticks from Lunar New Year.
I have half a box. I can bring them to Flushing before the 5:30 at St. Michael if traffic is not bad.
Bring the oranges also. She wants the little table cleaned before dinner.
Ok. I will stop by first, then go straight there.
Ma found the envelope with the old airport pictures. Do you want me to bring it Sunday?
Yes please. I can clean the faded ones tonight after the soup is done.
There is one of you in that big jacket outside the Queens building.
I remember that jacket. I had Coltrane playing last time I fixed a photo from that stack.
You passed the shop earlier? I saw somebody with your old Canon by the tire place.
That was me. The light on Hollis Ave was good before the rain, so I stopped for a few corners.
Send me the one with the puddle when you clean it up. Looks like something for your little paint papers too.
Tonight maybe. I want to fix the crooked sign first, then see if I can keep the puddle shine with the brush.
Ma said you sounded tight on the phone. Come Flushing later if you can, but walk first if needed.
I will do Cunningham before the pharmacy. The trees are starting already, so it is easier to make myself go.
Good. Text when you're done, then I will send the medicine list.
Ok. Same route I liked in October, just slower today.
For the family timeline, do I put the Queens oath photo after the move from Manila or after you and Tita Teresa started school here?
After school here. That photo was years later. The Manila part is just the start of the line.
Got it. Also is Sept 18 the date you want next to the first baby photo, or just the year?
Put Sept 18. Your lola will correct us if I leave it vague.
You still need my folding table Saturday or did the church basement find one?
Need yours. I am doing the noodle broth first, then they make the herb plates in pairs.
Pairs is smart. Some of those aunties sit like nobody sees them until food comes out.
That is why I want extra chairs near the pot, not a line and plastic trays.
Before you leave, try Corazon early. Teresa texted that the building plumber comes at 8.
Calling now. If she gets rushed I will stop in Flushing Friday instead of Saturday.
Good. Also ask if Ramon mailed the Jersey City check or if Teresa needs cash tonight.
Ma asked if you still need to wear mask Sunday after your shot.
I told her yes in the clinic waiting room and on the bus. Dr. Morales' office said still better around her.
Good. She saw a video from cousin's page and got nervous. I told her we follow the doctor paper, not videos.
Bring the paper when I come. Marielle can read the small print on video call if needed.
Coffee tomorrow or you still doing the home version?
Home version. Thermos and Aldi bread this week.
That office near Hillside call you back?
They did. I told them after the next two Fridays. Envelope stays closed until then.
Nico's school portal still has the family background page open. It asks race line and the origin yes/no again.
I will finish after coffee. For me it is the same answer I gave the clinic: no on that origin line, then the box with the notes for both sides.
Add the house languages too? Teacher asked what he hears at home.
Put English plus the two from my parents, and that he mostly answers in English unless Lola starts with food questions.
I left your clean shirt on the bed for the center tonight. Eat first.
I will. I printed the questions: complaint receipts, softer first words, and a separate number for people acting strange on the street.
Good. Remember Mrs. Alvarez is scared walking from bingo. Ask about that.
Yes. Also I put my license and registration in the clear sleeve. No digging around if they check the car outside.
Dad I cleaned the spreadsheet tab. The March totals are locked so you don't have to keep rechecking the same cells.
Thank you. I opened it after dinner and then again during the Knicks game. Got annoyed when Nico asked for the charger.
Leave it closed tonight. Also did you do the breathing thing before coffee like they told you?
Morning yes, afternoon no. I bought pretzels after everyone slept last night, so I know I was wound up.
Ma's van ride got moved to 2:15. Also the mailer from Ramos says they protect elder meals but no number.
Bring it Saturday. I keep the ones with real numbers and toss the smiling-festival ones.
You and your folder.
Folder helps. Clinic fees, language desk, bus cuts, school seats. Same questions every year.
Mom's pharmacy ride came to $46. I can cover today if you already filled the school envelope.
I put Nico's activity money there yesterday. Medical envelope has $38 after the receipt from Monday.
Send me your half after Friday then. Don't touch the house-repair cash if Jun still needs that part.
Okay. I will enter it on the sheet tonight so March does not creep past the line.
Mama's pharmacy total is $47. I can pay today if you send half Friday.
Send me the photo. Friday is fine after the flooring job pays.
Also the clinic desk asked again for your household paper if you bring Nico next month. They said blank is okay where there is no case number.
Blank then. I only have pay stubs, rent receipt, and the premium notice.
You still going to Nico's school thing tonight?
Yes. I am keeping my mouth shut unless that one parent starts the 2020 nonsense again.
Then stand near the coffee and count to five. Let the kid have his night.
I know. Nico's part has our food, Lani's recipe card, and the blank cards for everyone else. That's the main thing.
You still coming by the shop after Aldi?
Yes. Bringing the Thelonious record you said skips on track 2.
Good. Coffee is terrible here but the back door has sun today.
That back door sun on the oil cans is the only reason your coffee survives.
Leaving Mr. Santos at 6:15. Did you eat or only drink coffee?
I ate soup. March sheet says net in $4,300 so far after the two deposits and Marielle books transfer.
Good. Pay water first, then don't touch the rest until I sit with you.
Water scheduled. Aldi list done. I won't move anything else.
I am stopping at H Mart. Do we still need mint or you have enough outside?
Skip mint. Basil too. Please get onions and fish sauce only.
Good. Save me the small tomato if it turns red by Sunday.
I will be home 10:40. Please leave my tea mug by the sink.
Done. I put the phone in the hallway before the game clips pull me in.
And cover the ice cream. Nico needs some for tomorrow.
Covered already. I am brushing after tea.
I added the receipts tab. The H Mart line and Aldi line are separate now.
Thank you. Tonight was lentils, carrot ends, celery leaves, and the last broth cube.
That actually sounds good. Did you freeze some?
Two containers. I will get greens from the market by the bus on Sunday if they look fresh.
I found the photo from the church hall in 1998. You and Ma look so serious with that tiny cake.
That cake was cheap but good. We were tired even before you and Nico started running us around.
Send it to the group chat before Sunday. Also can you leave my old MetroCard on my desk for break?
I will. Your desk is still buried under sociology books and Nico's extra controller.
You sent me that diner plate at 1am then a light tunnel thing. Couldn't sleep?
Just scrolling after dishes. The tunnel was from a museum page, not my photo.
The sax clip was good though. Send the guy's handle again when you get coffee.
I will. He posts from the 7 train platforms sometimes.
I picked up ginger and calamansi. Do you still want peanuts for later?
Yes, small bag only. First pitch is around dinner and I do not want to cook again after the 5th.
Then rice first, TV after. No shouting if Nico is doing homework.
I will use the quiet voice unless the bullpen makes it impossible.
I added a tab to the budget sheet for your morning log. Just date, two cuff numbers, scale number, steps.
Thank you anak. I can use that. The paper notebook gets messy with grocery receipts.
Also campus party tonight and I am copying your style: one can, then water. No weird pens or gummies from strangers.
Good. Same rule here at Tito Ben's tomorrow. One bottle with food, then coffee, and I keep the Advil bottle closed unless the knee wins.
